scope: Opt-in adapter applies restricted saturated-domain trial contributions to actual reference_richards_workspace_t residual and dfdh_main arrays; existing workspace type and production HeadCalc are unchanged
contract: Caller identifies expected positive workspace generation. Reject poisoned, released, generation-mismatched, wrong-node-count or malformed workspaces before candidate assembly; invalidate prior output transfer. Reuse atomic residual/diagonal assembly. Do not initialize, reset or resize a caller workspace implicitly.
tests: Real workspace initialize, successful residual/diagonal contribution, unchanged ordinary source/sink and off-diagonals, internal transfer balance, reinitialization generation mismatch, poison rejection, reset recovery and release rejection.
compiler_note: Wno-unused-dummy-argument accommodates intentionally unused arguments in existing abstract solver default; other warnings remain errors and bounds/FPE checks remain active.
limitations: No HeadCalc invocation or nonlinear matrix solve. Ordinary reset does not advance existing workspace generation, so callers must explicitly discard records at trial boundaries. Workspace generations are not global identities: caller must retain the originating workspace association. No accepted state, runtime receipt, restart or production physics admission.

transfer_lifetime_extension.interface_change: PPA-local apply_saturated_reference_scratch now returns private reference_trial_transfer instead of raw macro_used_exchange. Only its test caller existed and was updated; frozen solver ABI unchanged.
transfer_lifetime_extension.contract: copy_reference_transfer checks current generation, active nodes, poison and allocated residual before extracting candidate amount. Workspace mismatch invalidates the record permanently; explicit discard is provided for same-generation reset boundaries.
transfer_lifetime_extension.tests: Read valid transfer, reject it after reinitialize without first reevaluating, reject on poison, prevent revival after subsequent reset, explicit discard, and release rejection.
transfer_lifetime_extension.test_result: Persisted 0ee6d55f3 scratch-binding and restricted-evaluator gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and runtime checks

linear_storage_composition.scope: Manufactured closed-exchange matrix storage law dtheta/dh=1, weighted by explicit static matrix fraction and layer thickness. Real bounded macropore residual/derivative callbacks are iterated at dt=0.5,1,2. Not full Richards or production physics qualification.
linear_storage_composition.checks: Converged head independently determines matrix storage change; it matches captured transfer and cancels macropore storage change. Deliberately omitting matrix fraction gives a detectable balance error. No owner commit or source equation changes.
linear_storage_composition.test_result: Persisted d8001e92e Richards scratch gate PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts, bounds checks and floating-point traps

static_matrix_fraction_component.source: Exact B1.11 macropore.f90 line 386: FrArMtrx = 1 - VlMpStCp / Dz
static_matrix_fraction_component.contract: Explicit static pore volume input; do not substitute total volume including dynamic cracks. Positive finite layer thickness, static volume in [0,dz], matching nonempty shapes. Failed evaluation returns no fraction array.
static_matrix_fraction_component.scope: Source-equation component for future typed HeadCalc geometry input, not yet wired into HeadCalc or inferred from the restricted domain's total-volume field. No shared ABI change or physical admission.
static_matrix_fraction_component.tests: Zero, partial and full static volume; excess/negative volume, zero thickness, shape mismatch and NaN rejection.

Failed extraction returns neither array. Candidate preparation now uses this rate directly instead of amount/dt.
exact_rate_extension.scope: Avoids a numerical round trip; does not alter source equations, tolerances, acceptance ownership or production admission.
exact_rate_extension.test_result: Persisted ef1a5e7d0 trial-exchange and Richards scratch gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and bounds/FPE checks. Exact rate copy, failed dual-output invalidation and preservation of a tiny rate when integrated amount underflows are tested.

candidate_bridge_contract.design: Capture immutable evaluator geometry with the used exchange. A new candidate preparation entry point checks checkpoint lineage/revision, single-domain extent, fixed volume and hydrostatic beginning profile before composing A3 interval preparation and accounting from the captured budget. Publish candidate and account only after all checks pass; never commit.
candidate_bridge_contract.limits: PPA-local proposed integration only. Inherits A3 conservative-flux reference-policy limitation; no complete continuation physics, production admission or restart qualification. Exact-rate extension removes amount/dt reconstruction from the A3 handoff.
candidate_bridge_contract.test_result: Persisted 8ce32fec8 Richards scratch and A3 interval candidate gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and bounds/FPE checks. Valid bridge, stale revision rejection, same-total wrong-profile rejection, recovery and unchanged initial state tested.

interval_handoff_verification.scope: Integration test feeds the actual captured restricted residual transfer into existing A3 interval candidate preparation and candidate mass accounting; no production or physical commit route enabled.

interval_handoff_verification.checks: Candidate preparation and per-cell/domain mass checks succeed; perturbing one matrix transfer by 0.01 cm rejects accounting. Candidate is discarded and initial owner revision/storage remain unchanged.

paired_storage_contract.design: Capture beginning and candidate scalar macropore storage in the private reference transfer record after successful residual/system assembly. Add copy_reference_budget requiring heads and duration, returning transfer and both captured stores together only on successful identity checks. Failure returns no amount and zero scalar outputs.
paired_storage_contract.scope: Restricted single-domain candidate budget only, not an A2 continuation payload or whole-column physical acceptance. No committed owner, frozen provider ABI or production HeadCalc changes.
paired_storage_contract.test_result: Persisted 560380b2a Richards scratch and saturated trial gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and runtime/FPE checks. Both assembly paths capture storage; later mutable-input changes leave the paired budget unchanged; invalid capture returns no amount and zero storage outputs.

backtracking_verification.scope: Manufactured nonlinear callback driver now starts with eightfold overrelaxation and halves the step until the residual norm drops by at least half. This deliberately exercises rejection and reevaluation; it is not the production HeadCalc line-search policy or legacy frozen-exchange branch.
backtracking_verification.checks: Each dt must reject at least one step and converge within 100 iterations to its analytic root. Rejected transfer is explicitly discarded, cannot be extracted, and initial store stays unchanged. Distinct evaluation keys are assigned to every trial. Final transfer is checked against final heads and duration.
backtracking_verification.finding: Accepting any residual decrease could stagnate beyond the bounded iteration count in this deliberately overrelaxed test. Requiring sufficient decrease resolves the test-driver issue without changing production or source derivatives.
backtracking_verification.test_result: Persisted 8ad20c8c1 Richards scratch and trial exchange gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts, bounds checks and floating-point traps

transfer_identity_contract.interface: Optional expected head and dt on transfer extraction validate exact finite residual identity and duration before returning integrated amounts. Legacy key-only reads remain unchanged. A failed checked read invalidates the reference adapter capture; raw scratch extraction remains read-only.
transfer_identity_contract.purpose: Prevent candidate mass accounting against changed heads or duration even if a caller reuses an evaluation key. These checks do not establish convergence, workspace identity across instances, or physical commit authority.
transfer_identity_contract.test_result: Persisted 67030f9e2 trial-exchange, Richards scratch and saturated-trial gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and bounds/FPE checks. Matching, changed, short and nonfinite heads; changed/nonfinite duration; raw read-only behavior and adapter invalidation tested.

head_identity_extension.interface: Optional trailing head vector on apply_macro_diagonal and apply_reference_trial_diagonal checks exact finite pressure-head identity against the captured residual before touching the diagonal. Existing callers without this argument retain key-only behavior; the nonlinear sequence supplies it.
head_identity_extension.invariants: No convergence tolerance substitutes for evaluation identity. A mismatch leaves diagonal unchanged and the reference adapter invalidates captured transfer. No solver or workspace ABI change, physical commit or production admission.
head_identity_extension.tests: Nonlinear iterations supply matching heads. After convergence, changed heads with the same key reject the tangent and invalidate transfer. Persisted fc15f6252 scratch and saturated trial gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and runtime/FPE checks.

reduced_nonlinear_gate.scope: Verification only: manufactured scalar matrix residual h-0.2 coupled to the real bounded head-derived macropore evaluator through separate residual and Jacobian callbacks. Not HeadCalc or a physical Richards column solve.
reduced_nonlinear_gate.oracle: For the two-cell fixture and positive bottom head below 0.5: q=min(0.25*(1-h),0.125/((h+0.5)*dt)). At dt=0.5, root h=0.36; at dt=1 and 2, root (-0.3+sqrt(0.49+0.5/dt))/2. The source quasi-Newton derivative is used, not replaced with the analytic derivative of the capped rate.
reduced_nonlinear_gate.invariants: Failed fully unsaturated trial followed by recovery; distinct evaluation keys during iterations; unchanged initial macropore store; final-used transfer captured without reevaluation; transfer/storage cancellation; old attempt rejected when extracting amounts; changed dt restarts from identical input history.
reduced_nonlinear_gate.test_result: Persisted b78d60526 Richards scratch and saturated trial gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts and runtime/FPE checks
reduced_nonlinear_gate.limits: No full matrix constitutive/storage law, line search, physical acceptance, committed restart or production admission. No shared interface changed.

split_callback_contract.design: Provide separate residual and diagonal scratch entry points matching vector_F then jacobian_F ordering. Residual captures evaluated transfer; diagonal consumes the paired derivative without reevaluating physical inputs. Caller must assign a distinct evaluation key whenever heads change and rebuild the base diagonal before each application.
split_callback_contract.failure: Rejected residual invalidates old capture without changing residual. Failed diagonal leaves diagonal unchanged and invalidates capture; it does not roll back the already assembled residual. Interval owner must reject that numerical trial. Disabled derivative preserves diagonal and retains valid transfer.
split_callback_contract.scope: PPA-local additive interface; production HeadCalc and frozen provider/workspace ABI unchanged. No special legacy frozen-exchange backtracking branch or physical commit admission.
split_callback_contract.test_result: Persisted 951c6ae1e scratch, saturated trial and rate-composition gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts, bounds checks and floating-point traps. Split callback tests cover untouched diagonal during residual, captured derivative despite subsequently changed physical input, disabled derivative, transfer balance, stale key invalidation, generation mismatch, malformed diagonal and failed residual invalidation.
